item.title: Dealing with 'donut holes': Why some Myrtle Beach residents aren't technically in the city
item.description: MYRTLE BEACH, S.C. (WBTW) -- The city of Myrtle Beach contains approximately 40 "donut holes," which are pockets of Horry County land surrounded by city limits. These areas remain under county governance, causing confusion for residents regarding taxes, zoning, and emergency services.
